_about: Corrections a reviewer made to the automatic alignment, applied by generate.py after aligning.
A review decides WHICH transcribed words belong to which identifier. It never decides that damaged
words stop counting: everything the recogniser wrote in place of an identifier stays marked, even when
it turned the name into ordinary words ('He fell' for 'Itzel', 'aquifer' for 'Okafor'), because someone
who knows the person can still recognise it. If the transcript no longer contains the text a correction
names, the generator fails rather than guessing.

corrections.why: The recogniser rewrote 'Li Wang. Li' as one block; the full name is the first two words.
Same block: the one-word mention is the second 'Lee', not the full name before it.
'Reporta Nayeli' became 'Reportan a Jelly': the verb absorbed one sound of the name and stays unmarked; everything written in place of the name is marked.
The recogniser rewrote 'Garcilazo. Chebo' as one block; the full name ends before the full stop.
Same block: the nickname is the word after the full stop.
